Definition
[$\kappa $-solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0064 1. ch28:28.19\group Three-Dimensional Singularity Models

A complete ancient solution is a $\kappa $-solution if it is nonflat, has nonnegative curvature operator, is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales, and has uniformly bounded scalar curvature.
